name: breezetype
description: Search your BreezeType dictations, meetings and Ambient Notes from ChatGPT and Codex. Runs on your Mac through BreezeType's local MCP server.

interface.longDescription: Search what you dictated with BreezeType, your meeting notes, summaries and transcripts, and Ambient Notes, all read locally on this Mac. You can also ask for a meeting note or summary, which BreezeType shows for your approval before anything changes. Requires the BreezeType Mac app.
defaultPrompt: What did we decide in my last meeting?
